jobs.title: Senior Creative Strategist (f/m/d)
jobs.description:
Über uns

Mutabor
ist die größte unabhängige internationale Markenagentur, die in Deutschland gegründet wurde. Die Inhaber, Johannes Plass und Heinrich Paravicini, sind bis heute Teil der 6-köpfigen Geschäftsführung.

200 + Creative Consultants in Hamburg, Berlin und Los Angeles schaffen wirkungsvolle Lösungen, die auf ganzheitlichen Strategien, großartigem Design und modernster Technologie basieren.

Unter dem Leitmotiv »Brand Intelligence® unterstützt Mutabor Marken dabei, nicht nur relevant, sondern resilient und zukunftsfähig zu werden. Die Dienstleistungen umfassen u.a.: strategische Beratung, Gestaltung und adaptive Designsysteme inklusive Packaging, Live- und Digital Experience, Kommunikation sowie Brand Management.
Zu den Kund:innen gehören u.a. BMW-Motorrad, BRENNTAG, Clariant, GEA, die DFL, Henkel, HelleniQ Energy, Kleinanzeigen, Migros, OTTO, Pfizer, Porsche, Veltins und Volkswagen.

Mutabor ist der lateinische Ausdruck für den Willen zur Veränderung (ich werde verwandelt werden – i'm going to change). Dieser Wille treibt Mutabor seit der Gründung 1998 an. Mit über 700 Awards, unzähligen Projekten für Kund:innen fast aller Branchen – von Start-ups bis zu internationalen Konzernen – gehört Mutabor heute zu den größten unabhängigen Agenturen der Kreativbranche in Deutschland.

Deine Aufgaben

Als Senior Creative Strategist (f/m/d) bei Mutabor Advertising bist du die strategische Instanz im Team: Du entwickelst eigenverantwortlich Kampagnenstrategien und Markenpositionierungen, gibst der Kreation die richtigen Sprungbretter und bringst Kund:innen auf Entscheider:innen-Ebene klare strategische Orientierung. Du übernimmst Projekte von Anfang bis Ende - von der Analyse über die Konzeption bis zur Präsentation. Dabei arbeitest du eng mit Kreation und Beratung zusammen und wirkst punktuell auch bereichsübergreifend mit Expert:innen aus Brand Design, UX/UI Design, Motion Design und Architektur.
Du verantwortest und entwickelst eigenständig Kampagnenstrategien, Markenpositionierungen und zielgruppenspezifische Kommunikationsframeworks - von der Analyse bis zur Präsentation.
Du führst tiefgehende Markt-, Wettbewerbs- und Zielgruppenanalysen durch und leitest daraus klare, überzeugende strategische Empfehlungen ab.
Du übersetzt Daten, Recherchen und kulturelle Beobachtungen in umsetzbare Strategien und kreative Leitideen, die der Kreation echten Auftrieb geben.
Du planst und moderierst Kund:innenworkshops und -präsentationen und führst diese souverän durch.
Du bringst dich aktiv in New-Business-Initiativen ein - von der Konzeption bis zur Präsentation.
Du behältst den Überblick über strategische Projektprozesse, sorgst für Transparenz gegenüber allen Stakeholder:innen und steuerst (Teil-)Projekte eigenverantwortlich.
Du treibst die Weiterentwicklung von Arbeitsmethoden, Tools und Prozessen im Strategiebereich voran und gibst dein Wissen an Kolleg:innen in deinem Team weiter.

Deine Qualifikationen

Du hast ein abgeschlossenes Studium, z. B. in Kommunikationswissenschaft, Marketing, BWL, Wirtschaftspsychologie oder einem vergleichbaren Bereich.
Du bringst mindestens 5 Jahre Berufserfahrung in einer Kommunikations- oder Markenstrategie-Agentur mit.
Du hast nachweisliche Erfahrung in der eigenverantwortlichen Führung von Strategie-Projekten und im direkten Kund:innenkontakt.
Du arbeitest strukturiert, formulierst komplexe Inhalte klar und verständlich und erstellst überzeugende Präsentationen, die Wirkung entfalten.
Du verfügst über sehr gute Kenntnisse in MS Office – insbesondere PowerPoint – sowie Erfahrung mit strategischen Research-Tools wie Statista oder best4planning.
Du erkennst Potenziale frühzeitig, bringst proaktiv Impulse ein und gibst strategische Impulse sowohl nach innen als auch nach außen.
Du hast sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift.
Du hast ein ausgeprägtes Gespür für (unterhaltsame) Werbung, kulturelle Trends und kommunikationswirksame Ideen.

Wir bieten

Sei Teil der kreativsten Designagentur Deutschlands.
Hier findest du den Austausch und die Zusammenarbeit in einem interdisziplinären Team. Von Corporate Design, UX-UI-Design über Architektur bis hin zu Motion Design - für jeden Kopf finden wir den richtigen Hut.
Unser Office in Hamburg bietet nicht nur ein eigenes Café, Dachterrasse mit Grill und Blick über den Hafen, sondern auch einen modernen Arbeitsplatz mit neuester Technik.
Es finden regelmäßig Inhouse-Veranstaltungen zu Fortbildung und Teambuilding statt. Jeden Freitag lassen wir gemeinsam die Woche bei einem Drink ausklingen.
Du willst deine Sprachkenntnisse verbessern? Kein Problem, nimm Teil an unseren kostenlosen Deutsch- und Englischkursen.
Neben den 30 Tagen Urlaub, bekommst du zusätzlich an deinem Geburtstag einen Tag als Geschenk oben drauf.
Es gibt Möglichkeiten der Entgeltoptimierung (Deutschlandticket, Jobrad) und Unterstützung bei der betrieblichen Altersvorsorge.
Kontinuierliche und individuelle Weiterbildungsangebote sowie Entwicklungsgespräche.

jobs.description:
CapsLock is a global IT marketing company that pioneers unique, scalable customer acquisition solutions for B2C clients. We solve complex sales challenges across a wide range of industries, primarily for large North American partners. By integrating our expertise in Digital Marketing, IT, Design, AI-driven analytics, proprietary MarTech, and sales consulting we deliver powerful, data-informed customer acquisition solutions.

At CapsLock, people, technology, and forward-thinking innovation lie at the heart of everything we do. Our core values guide our approach to building and refining an internal product ecosystem that powers profitable acquisition models, flexible scaling, and optimized operations. Our diverse, global team, fluent in over 10 languages, thrives on open collaboration and the exchange of new ideas, pushing boundaries to ensure our clients’ success.

Role Overview

Our Design department is scaling its AI visual production capabilities - and we're looking for a Senior AI Creative Designer
who will produce high-quality visual creatives
with the primary goal of improving conversion rates
. We’re looking for a designer who is deeply engaged with the fast-moving AI landscape, proactively tests new tools, features, and approaches, and is driven to continuously improve how AI is used in day-to-day creative work.This role sits at the intersection of creative storytelling, generative AI, and performance marketing - creating visual assets that capture attention and convert cold traffic across Facebook, Instagram, YouTube, Google, and landing pages: from static ads to lifestyle imagery and photorealistic human characters.

You will work closely with marketers, copywriters, media production, and video editors to produce assets that are photorealistic, visually compelling, and true to client product specifications.

Responsibilities

AI Visual Production:

Create high-quality AI-generated visuals for performance marketing campaigns across paid media channels and landing pages.
Produce photorealistic human imagery, lifestyle scenes, and product-focused visuals.
Work with source materials from photo shoots - enhance, retouch, and extend imagery using AI tools.
Generate multiple creative variations to support testing and scaling across campaigns.
Ensure consistency with brand guidelines and product requirements across all assets.

Creative Iteration & Testing:

Iterate on visual concepts based on performance data and creative feedback.
Explore different visual angles, hooks, and formats to improve conversion rates.
Collaborate with copywriters and marketers to align visuals with messaging and funnel logic.
Translate briefs into multiple creative directions, not just single outputs.

Quality & Realism:

Ensure high visual quality and realism (lighting, composition, anatomy, textures).
Identify and fix common AI issues (artifacts, distortions, inconsistencies).
Maintain a strong visual standard across all generated content.

AI Tools & Workflow:

Use modern AI tools and models to generate, refine, and enhance visual assets.
Actively research, test, and integrate new AI tools to improve output quality.
Work within structured production workflows with a focus on execution and creative output.

Performance & Optimization:

Understand how visual content impacts campaign performance and audience engagement.
Adjust creative output based on data and testing results.
Support A/B testing by delivering multiple creative variants.

Collaboration:

Work closely with marketers, copywriters, media production, and video editors to ensure creative alignment.
Provide visual input during concept development and campaign planning.
Ensure assets are structured and ready for use in video production and marketing funnels.
Document all tasks clearly in ClickUp per team standards.

Requirements:

Skills & Background:

3-5+ years of experience in design, visual content creation, or creative digital marketing (paid social, social media content, performance campaigns)
1-2+ year of active hands-on experience with AI image generation platforms (Figma Weave, Higgsfield, Magnific, Runway, or similar) - producing photorealistic human imagery, lifestyle scenes, and product-focused visuals.
Cross-platform proficiency, experience in connecting AI outputs with traditional design pipelines (Figma, Adobe Creative Suite).
Strong visual sense: composition, lighting, color, typography, realism, and human anatomy.
AI-Geek: stays close to AI news and new releases, experiments hands-on with emerging features and workflows, and is constantly looking for smarter ways to improve the quality, speed, and effectiveness of creative work.
Ability to conduct audience/target group research and reflect it properly in the visuals
Understanding of performance marketing basics (CTR, hooks, conversion-focused creative).
Ability to iterate quickly based on feedback and data.
Strong attention to detail and visual quality.
Proactive mindset - suggesting improvements, not just executing tasks.
Clear communication and strong collaboration skills.
Portfolio with AI-generated photorealistic visuals demonstrating quality and high-end visual sensibility.
Upper-intermediate English (B2) or higher.

Nice to Have:

Basic understanding of how static visuals translate into video production pipelines.
Experience producing creative assets for high-CPA verticals (home services, insurance, finance, or similar).
Comfortable working in a fast-moving environment with evolving priorities.

﻿

Remote Work - we offer a truly and fully remote environment. You choose where you are the most productive and comfortable to have an impact.
Paid vacations - generous paid vacation policy to ensure you have time to recharge
Unlimited Sick Days - we understand that being only human means getting sick or feeling under the weather from time to time, so we guarantee you time off as long as you need to recover and get back on your feet.

Home Office - we will cover the equipment and furniture expenses to make sure you have the best work-from-home experience.
Physical Well–Being - We will cover costs of your medical insurance. Additionally we offer an allowance for a flexible fitness program.
Fun Stuff - there is never a shortage of fun stuff

jobs.description:
Fuse Energy is an energy startup on a mission to make energy abundant and affordable, fast. We combine first-principles thinking with cutting-edge technology to build a radically better energy system.

We've raised over $200M from top-tier investors including Balderton, Lakestar, Accel, Creandum, Lowercarbon, Ribbit, 20VC, Hummingbird and Collaborative Fund, alongside strategic angels including Nico Rosberg and GPs behind Meta, Revolut, Spotify and Uber.

We're building a fully integrated energy company: developing our own solar, batteries and other generation projects, building our own hardware, improving and developing grid infrastructure, trading power in real time, using AI across the business, and installing distributed energy in homes. By selling directly to consumers we cut out the middleman, lower costs and pass the savings on to our customers.

We're building our own in-house content and creative team. Unlike most companies, it won't sit inside marketing as another growth channel; it runs as its own function with one objective: to make Fuse, and the abundant future we're building, impossible to ignore. As a Creative Producer, you make our campaigns happen. You, the designers and art directors run as a tag team: they own the idea and the look, you own the intelligence and the delivery. Together you take a campaign from the first insight to the final file, and when we work with external partners, you find, brief and run them.

Responsibilities

Gather the insights campaigns are built on: competitor research, category research and what's working in culture right now
Brainstorm positioning and messaging with the head of content, art director, design and whichever teams the campaign touches
Find and assess external agencies and freelancers, and write the creative briefs they work from
Run production logistics: locations, scheduling, kit, and booking the talent and crew the art director has chosen
Own the shot list and asset plan before every shoot, so one shoot day yields many assets across ads, social and campaign
Work with social strategists and creators to plan the assets they need and roll each campaign out across platforms
On big hero films, act as in-house executive producer: commission and run the named freelance crew (director, DOP, colourist, sound) and own the budget
Keep every production moving so nothing stalls or slips

Requirements

Organisation: you run the logistics, schedule and budget and keep a shoot with many moving parts on the rails, arriving with the full asset plan and leaving with every asset in the can
Problem-solving under pressure: you hold the schedule and budget when things go wrong on shoots, and protect the creative while you solve it
3+ years as a producer, with real strategic curiosity, a range of produced video and campaigns, and strong management of crews, vendors and agencies

Benefits

Competitive salary and eligibility for equity
Biannual bonus scheme
Fully expensed tech to match your needs
Private health insurance
Breakfast and dinner allowance for office-based employees

As we hire globally, benefits vary by location.

The role will help manage and evolve the creative process, fostering strong collaboration across internal teams, commercial partners, production teams, editorial and external creative talent. This encompasses digital, social, print, moving image, stills and product.
This is an opportunity for a highly capable senior creative to play a central role within a dynamic, creative and entrepreneurial environment, working across a diverse portfolio of global opportunities.

Lead day-to-day creative development and execution across campaigns, social, editorial, digital, film, photography and commercial partnerships.
Maintain a best-in-class creative standard, facilitating ideation and content creation internally and externally, ensuring consistency, quality and continued elevation of the David Beckham brand.

Provide creative leadership and direction to internal teams and external creative partners, helping to get the best from multidisciplinary teams and high-profile talent.
Contribute creative thinking to new business development and partnership opportunities.
Oversee design output, including client presentations, and ensure effective organisation and filing of creative assets.
Build and maintain a network of high-level creative talent, including directors/ photographers/ editors, scriptwriters, DOPs and other creative specialists, bringing fresh thinking and expertise into the business.
Stay ahead of current and emerging trends across photography, fashion, lifestyle, film and social media, bringing relevant global perspectives and new approaches into the work.

Must Haves

8-10 years’ experience in a Senior Creative or similar role.
Strong experience in art direction within an advertising or creative agency, with high-level editorial experience across fashion, sport and/or lifestyle.
A highly creative thinker with the ability to generate, develop and articulate strong ideas.
Ability to shape creative concepts around brand and partner objectives, existing brand DNA, audience, cultural context and emerging trends.

Confident stepping into a leadership role, providing creative direction and deputising for senior creative leadership when required.

About Us

We are Dragons, a global creative agency working with bold brands to build cultural relevance, connection, and long-term impact through strategy-led creativity.

About the Role

We’re looking for a Creative Director with strong conceptual thinking, great visual taste and experience working across global wellness and lifestyle brands.
Someone who can move comfortably between product and lifestyle, science and culture, and who understands how creative needs to work across the full consumer journey.
You might be working on a product with a complex ingredient or efficacy story one day, developing a talent-led campaign the next, and figuring out how that same brand idea translates into more product-focused or conversion-driven work further down the funnel.
This is a global role, so we’re looking for someone who is comfortable developing ideas that can travel across markets and cultures without becoming generic.
You’ll lead creative development across global wellness, beauty-adjacent and lifestyle brands, from early concepts and campaign platforms through to production and execution.
We’re looking for someone who cares about the idea as much as the craft, but also understands what the creative is there to do.
You’ll work hand in hand with Strategy, as well as Copy, Design, Social and Production, to understand the audience, cultural context, role of each channel and each stage of the funnel, and translate that thinking into strong creative.
This isn’t purely an art direction role. You need to be able to come up with strong campaign ideas, build on other people’s ideas and turn them into something bigger.

Key Responsibilities

Develop strong global campaign ideas and creative platforms that can live across markets, channels and executions.
Partner closely with strategists from the beginning of the process, challenging and building on briefs rather than simply receiving them.
Understand the role creative plays across the full funnel, from building awareness and brand desire to communicating product benefits, driving consideration and supporting conversion.
Know when an execution needs to build the brand, when it needs to explain the product and when it simply needs to make someone want it.
Turn strategy, product benefits and consumer insights into simple, relevant creative ideas.
Build global creative platforms that have a clear central idea while leaving enough room for markets to make them culturally relevant.
Lead the visual direction of brands across product, lifestyle, talent and culture-led work.
Find interesting ways to communicate ingredients, efficacy, innovation and science without everything suddenly looking clinical.
Make products feel desirable through photography, film, CGI, design, casting, styling and storytelling.
Bring product and lifestyle together naturally, rather than creating a beautiful lifestyle campaign and remembering the product at the end.
Develop ideas around talent, creators, partnerships and cultural moments that make sense for the brand and the market.
Think beyond traditional campaign formats and identify opportunities across social, experiences, collaborations, entertainment and emerging culture.
Lead work from concept through production, keeping the original idea and level of craft intact along the way.
Present and sell creative thinking to senior clients and stakeholders across different markets.
Lead and develop multidisciplinary and international creative teams.

A Creative Director who is conceptually strong and visually sophisticated, with a portfolio that shows range.
Big campaign thinking
Ideas with a clear point of view that can become genuine global platforms, not just a collection of executions.
Strong visual taste
A great eye for photography, film, casting, styling, design and contemporary brand aesthetics.
Product storytelling
Experience making products, ingredients, technology or benefits interesting and desirable, especially when there’s real science or efficacy behind them.
Full-funnel creative thinking
An understanding of how people move from discovering a brand to considering and buying it, and how the creative job changes along the way.
Strong creative + strategy partnership
Someone who likes working closely with strategists, has a point of view on the brief and knows how to turn strategic thinking into creative opportunities.
Global thinking
Experience developing work for multiple markets and understanding the difference between a global idea and simply making the same campaign appear everywhere. You should be comfortable collaborating with local teams and adapting ideas around different cultural behaviors and audiences without losing the core creative thought.
Lifestyle and culture
Work that shows an understanding of how brands can play in culture through talent, creators, collaborations, social, entertainment and experiences.
Range
We want someone who can create a beautiful product or efficacy story and then switch gears into a culturally relevant lifestyle campaign without either feeling forced.

Key Requirements

10+ years of creative experience, ideally across agencies and/or ambitious consumer brands.
Significant experience working on global brands and international campaigns.
Experience leading integrated and full-funnel campaigns, from brand-building through product and conversion-focused creative.
Background in wellness, beauty, personal care, lifestyle, premium CPG or adjacent categories.

Karla Otto is a globally recognized public relations and communications agency, founded in 1982, with offices in 15 key cities across the UK, EMEA, US, and Asia. With a strong presence in fashion capitals such as Milan, London, Paris, and New York, the agency has built a reputation for representing some of the most prestigious names in fashion, beauty, and lifestyle.

In 2017, Karla Otto merged with K2 to form THE INDEPENDENTS, a global marketing, design, and communications group. This collective brings together industry leaders who share a commitment to innovation, excellence, and thoughtful collaboration across the luxury and lifestyle sectors.

At Karla Otto, our team of expert strategists, designers, planners and publicists are dedicated to delivering exceptional results and establishing long-term partnerships with our clients. We are passionate about the world of fashion, beauty, and luxury, with everyone bringing their unique expertise and insights to the table. We are driven by a shared commitment to excellence and a deep understanding of the ever-evolving industry landscape.

The Senior Strategist is a senior member of Karla Otto’s Creative Strategy division, working across UK client teams, selected global clients and new business. The role combines creative strategy, cultural insight and concept development across fashion, beauty, lifestyle, hospitality and FMCG.

Working closely with the Creative Strategy leadership team, the Senior Strategist translates strategic direction into clear, compelling ideas and platforms across campaigns, content, experiences and programming. They will lead client briefs and presentations, develop creative-led work and contribute to new business and the continued growth of the Creative Strategy offer.

Cultural fluency is central to the role. The Senior Strategist brings a strong understanding of the creative and cultural landscape, alongside the network and judgement to identify relevant talent, creators, partners and collaborators and translate emerging cultural shifts into original, future-facing ideas.

This is a senior, client-facing role for an ideas-led creative with strong conceptual judgement, cultural intelligence and an active industry network. The role also offers opportunities to develop commercial and team leadership skills, with scope to progress to Director based on demonstrated readiness.

Key Responsibilities

CREATIVE

Lead creative strategy and concept development on assigned UK client briefs, from identifying the opportunity through to campaigns, content, experiences and programming, alongside selected global clients and pitches.
Translate cultural and creative shifts into original thinking for client work and new business.
Lead the creative direction and quality of assigned work, aligning with the Director on strategic direction and the SVP on departmental standards.
Develop the strategic foundation for creative-led briefs and partner with the Director where broader brand or business strategy is required.
Identify and shape experience-led and Insights-led opportunities in partnership with Special Projects and Insights respectively.
Identify and recommend talent, creators, partners and collaborators, working with the Talent team where relevant.
Lead client conversations, presenting and defending strategic and creative recommendations and identifying opportunities to develop the work.

NEW BUSINESS & GROWTH

Lead the creative response on assigned UK and relevant global pitches, with strategic and commercial guidance from the Director and SVP.
Identify opportunities across existing clients and new prospects, and develop and sell Creative Strategy work alongside the senior team.
Build integrated proposals with Insights, Communications, Talent, Beauty, Strategy, Special Projects and other divisions.
Contribute to scoping and pricing, accounting for resourcing, production requirements and profitability, with final commercial approval from the senior team.

TEAM & DIVISION DEVELOPMENT

Coordinate workflow and delivery on assigned briefs, identify resource needs and flag scope or budget pressures to the Director and SVP.
Guide colleagues and external collaborators, giving clear creative feedback and supporting the development of junior team members.
Maintain and grow the external creative network required to deliver work at the right standard.

6–8 years’ experience in creative strategy, creative direction or an equivalent agency role, with a focus on social and digital channels, programming and experiential work.
A strong portfolio spanning campaigns, content, experiences, programming and brand platforms.

Deep reference knowledge across fashion, art, design, music, film and photography, with the instinct to spot what is emerging, anticipate where culture is moving and translate this into original creative thinking.

Experience leading creative and project teams, directing external collaborators and giving clear creative feedback.

Strong proficiency in Keynote; working knowledge of Adobe Creative Suite advantageous.
Commercial awareness and experience working with budgets, resources and delivery processes, with the ambition to develop broader leadership responsibility.
